question: What is the total revenue (price times quantity) from completed orders placed by customers in 'Boston'? Round to 2 decimal places. Return a single column named total_revenue.

gold.sql: SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(p.price * oi.quantity), 0), 2) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND c.city = 'Boston'
